messages:
maria: Heads-up: staging canary promotion stopped by CI. deploy-bot paused due to image unpack error in staging job.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: job `ci/staging/unpack-image` failed. Full log: https://ci.internal/redwood/1768629000
lee: Key log lines:
```
[2026-03-21T13:02:11Z] unpacking layer 3/6
tar: ./sbin/entry: Cannot change permissions to 04755: Permission denied
ERROR: failed to unpack layer: operation not permitted
```
ana: We started using `ubuntu:22.04-minimal` last week. This smells like setuid bits or fmode preservation + rootless runner behaviour.
maria: Change window is open. Proposal: temporary pin base to last-known-good digest sha256:abcdef1234 to unblock release; follow up with RCA.
ops-bot: Manual pin allowed. Promotion will remain blocked until a green CI run and manual approval.
lee: I'll open a small PR to revert the Dockerfile base to sha256:abcdef1234 and add a rootless unpack smoke test to CI.
deploy-bot: PR #5499 opened; CI triggered.
deploy-bot: CI for PR #5499 finished: success.
maria: Requesting manual promote now.
maria: /promote rel-2026-03-21 --manual
deploy-bot: Promotion request recorded. Required approvals: eng-releases (lee), eng-sre (ana).
lee: Approved.
nana: Approved.
deploy-bot: Promotion started: canary rollout 0% -> 15% -> 45% -> 100%. Health checks all green. Promotion complete.
maria: Release unblocked. Creating follow-up ticket RW-3729 to investigate rootless unpack behaviour and decide fix (strip setuid, adjust umask, or avoid minimal base).
nana: Draft release note: "Temporarily pinned base image after image unpack permission errors on rootless CI runners; fix under investigation."
lee: I'll add repro steps with podman rootless and a suggested patch to strip suid during build to the ticket.
maria: Thanks team, closing thread.
